verse: etat pūjākramaṃ ghoraṃ vīradravyaiśca sarvataḥ | pūjayet parayā bhaktyā nirvikalpatayā saha
kālāntare tu saṃprāpte vakṣyāmi tu yathā tathyam  ||1/ 53 ||
krameṇa sarva tu * *? sthitiḥ sā sarvatomukhī | tataḥ saṃhārakāraṇī kramavijñānabhakṣaṇī
sthitisthaṃ dvādaśamaṃ yad vai daśapaṃcamakaṃ viduḥ | sṛṣṭipañcamakaṃ yat tu saṃhārādaṣṭame yutam
uddharet tu viśānena sṛṣṭidaśamasaṃyutam | aṣṭamena adhaḥkrāntaṃ caturdaśamasaṃyutam
melāpe militā sā vai sparśasya paramā citiḥ | (2) cakṣurmadhye sthitā yā vai candrārkadvayabhāsakī
3/ cidbhānuścitsvarūpatvāccandraṃśeṣu ca madhyagā | (?) anākhyā ca sthitāstatra cakracakreśvarī sadā
sṛṣṭicakrasya ādau tu ṣoḍaśāni samāsataḥ | varṇāni kālakāmāntu pūrvādīśānaka kramāt
arūpā sarvarūpā ca mantrabhūmistu sā viduḥ | yā vāktraye atītā yā parārūpe khageśvarī
kramaṃ tu paramaṃ dhāma labhyate tatkṣaṇādapi | siddhiyogini divyaṃ vai ka* *? bhāvya yatnataḥ | pāramparyakramāyātaṃ mukhādmukhagataṃ mahat
siddhāśca parameśāni tvatprasādāvatāritāḥ | pāramparyakramāyātā mukhāmukhayane sthitāḥ
guruprasādāt prāpyaitāḥ ko narastiṣṭhate bhuvi | śrībhairava uvāca caturviṃśatiryā devyaḥ śrutā me tvatprasādataḥ
na lekhyāni ca bodhātmā na vadet sarvamadhyataḥ | na pāṭhaṃ teṣu nāmeṣu kartavyaṃ vācayā hara
abhakṣā sarvabhakṣā ca sthitā kālī taraṅgiṇī | atimārgena rephagaṃ takāratve ca ūrdhvagā
śrībhairava uvāca śrutaṃ me devadeveśi śāntaraśmisvarūpakam | aṣṭānāṃ tu yathā tathyaṃ yoginīnāṃ svabhāvagam
madirānandito bhūtvā parāśaktyā sunanditaḥ | uddharet tu yathā nyāyaṃ vidyā viśvaścarārcitā
etad varṇaṃ mahākālaṃ prathamaṃ sarvakāmadam | sṛṣṭicakrasya yad varṇaṃ prathamaṃ bhavanāśanam
yoginyo dvādaśa tatra yutaśca (?) tadanantaram | pīṭhāśca pīṭhasiddhāśca dūtayaśca sutejasaḥ
tasmiṃ cakre mahāghore mahāmātṛbhiḥ saṃkule | svavimarśadaśanibhā * * * * * * * *(?)
akramakramabhāvena kathayasva yathārthataḥ | śrībhairavyuvāca atyantagahanaṃ guhyaṃ melāpaṃ malavarjitam
sṛṣṭisthaṃ saptamaṃ yad vai saṃhārādaṣṭasaṃyutam | navamaṃ taṃ vijāniyād daśamaṃ tvadhunā śṛṇu
śrībhairavyuvāca idānīṃ śṛṇu deveśi sthiticakrasya yāṃ vidhim | pūjyate parayā bhaktyā svasthā sarvārthamadhyagā
ooṃkārāntāntabhāvena jñānaṃ prāpya nabhaṃ gatā | etāstu mūrtayaḥ proktāḥ sarvabhāve tu cāgragāḥ
sṛṣṭiprathamagaṃ gṛhya saṃhārasyāṣṭamayutam | pañcamaṃ tad vijānīyād vidyā pañcākṣarā bhavet
gurupāraṃparāyātaṃ vyomeśīnāṃ ca hṛdgatam | akathyaṃ paramaṃ yat tu mahārtha buddhidaṃ sadā
eta sa* * *? tathyaṃ kathayasva mamepsitam | śrībhairavyuvāca śṛṇu tattvaṃ yathārthaṃ vai sṛṣṭicakrasya yā vidhiḥ
bhavāmyadya vidhānajñe tad vadasva mamepsitam | śrībhairavyuvāca śṛṇvidānīṃ parāṃ vidyāṃ siddhānāṃ bodhadarśinām
carate sarvagānte yā mantrabhūmistu sā viduḥ | kodaṇḍe tu catudaṇḍā (?) daṇḍāntadvayadaṇḍaṇī
teṣāṃ madhyāt kramāṇāṃ tu ādau pūjyastu kaḥ kramaḥ | tat me kathaya suśroṇi vistareṇa yathāvidhiḥ
sthitinavamasaṃyuktaṃ etad varṇaṃ caturthakam | tatastu sthiticakraṃ taṃ daśamaṃ viddhi pañcamam
sṛṣṭicakrasya saṃsthānaṃ vidhinā śṛṇu īśvara | śrībhairava uvāca śrutaṃ me devadeveśi sthiticakre tu yat kramam
sākinī hākinībhiśca pūtanābhiḥ samāvṛtam | bhairavaistu māhāghoraiḥ sevyamānaṃ samantataḥ
antāntā tu anantā sā a ṛlāntamadhyagā | bindudvayasya madhyasthā prakaṭasthā tu turyagā
sthiticakrasya yad varṇaṃ dvitīyaṃ ca sarvakāmadam | etaccaturdaśaṃ varṇaṃ viddhi kālakṣayaṃkaram
sarvotkṛṣṭatamatve'aapi vimarśagrasanākulā | caturthīṃ laharīṃ viddhi śāṃbhavī kālabhakṣakī
durvijñeyaṃ durārādhyaṃ sarvadhā  sarvajantuṣu ||1/ 49 ||
śrībhairavyuvāca śṛṇu rudra pravakṣyāmi vidyāṃ teṣāṃ yathā sthitām | siddhānāṃ yoginīnāṃ ca sthiticakrasvarūpagā
śāstrāṇāṃ nicayaṃ pūrvaṃ śrutaṃ me tvadanugrahāt | teṣu madhyāt tamajñātaṃ jñeyaṃ kālikramaṃ yathā
See chapter 15/59 of the Aajñākhaṇḍa śrīmadduttaradigbhāge pīṭhaṃ pīṭhavaraṃ mahat | oḍḍiyānābhidhānante siddhiyoginisevitam
etat svarūpaṃ vidyānāṃ yoginīnāṃ tu dhurjaṭi | pūjayed yaḥ sudhībhaktyā tasya devyo varapradāḥ
mūrtināṃ vyomagā nātha yathānyāyaṃkramagatāḥ | sṛṣṭicakrasya yad varṇaṃ prathamaṃ śaktirūpakam
tāsāṃ jñānaṃ yathā mantro  melāpaṃ tu mahāmate ||2/23 ||
sadāśivo  bhairavaśca   nāgairnāgavaraistathā  ||1/ 47 ||
sarvatra uttamaṃ  jñeyaṃ  sarvālambaistu varjitam  ||2/8 ||
guptācāreṇa vai nityaṃ pañcadhā tu yathārthataḥ | idaṃ vai yoginīcakraṃ khecaratvapradāyakam
sārabhūtaṃ kramārthasya mantroddhāramidaṃ param | yena vijñātamātreṇa mantrāmantravido bhavet
saṃhāracakre deveśa trayodaśamamagrataḥ | uddharet tu vidhānena sṛṣṭirdaśamasaṃyutam
varṇaistu vanatau? * *? mantrabhūmistu sā viduḥ | kahīnā kādyagā svasthā kālākālakṣayākulā
? yogīśvarīpadaṃ padaṃ paścāt prero deyān padaṃ tataḥ | eṣā tu deva deveśi caturviṃśākṣarā smṛtā
sthiticakrasya deveśa daśamantraṃ samuddharet | caturthaṃ tat vijānīyāt sarvaiśvaryapravatakam
